decisions.reason: The page requires the patient be "otherwise well" and "remains well"; A encodes that, B leaves it out.

The page says "isolated rash ... without other symptoms" and lists Itchiness as a separate skin symptom, so the literal reading excludes itching; B left it out because hives itch, which is a clinical reading.

notes: Both builds passed and agreed on structure (any2 of four body-system groups, generalised urticaria and serious single-system signs → probable Anaphylaxis; isolated urticaria with every other sign recorded absent → probable Non-allergic hypersensitivity reaction). Base A (it encodes 'otherwise well' and 'without other symptoms' more fully), with B's three concept choices (warm, hearing, cramps) and without A's 'Feeling faint' heading-as-symptom. The 'improve quickly (minutes)?' branch remains unrepresentable in both: faint symptoms count toward the body-system count regardless, so anaphylaxis fires more often than the page. Oxygen sats < 92% is not in the pseudoallergic no-list (a measurement cannot be wrapped in no). Nine known_issues are the gate's string-match limitation for (no X) with a finding_site/qualifier.
